   **Баги и стабильность.**
      3 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: баги и стабильность.
      Период отзывов: 24 июл. 2026 г. - 13 окт. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают краши или нестабильность. Это actionable только при всплеске или после обновления; иначе часто baseline-шум.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _Jonathan Engstrom_, 13 окт. 2026 г., 1/5: "Seems to work OK, except that after sitting in the hot tub, by heart rate goes up, and somehow it detects I am stressed out to the max, kinda dumb. UPDATE: This app has become total garbage in the past year or so. Says I am sleeping when I am sitting at my computer. I don't want to have to manually update sleep times because it's guesses suck. Mostly unusable at this point and useless. It's attitude that it knows best is stupid, it doesn't. Looking for replacement software."
            2. _James Anderson_, 12 окт. 2026 г., 1/5: "App freezes often."
            3. _Daniel Baumbart_, 27 сент. 2026 г., 1/5: "202609: app doesn't crash a lot anymore but I can't delete wrong automatic entries in sleep so the data is wrong and will get worse over time :( 202509: crashes a lot since the newest update"
